captions_meta.li_hook:
Announcements that land during the Christmas shutdown tend to disappear.
If it matters, publish before it.
li_body: From mid-December, many Australian newsrooms run skeleton crews until mid-January. Releases that land before the wind-down have a better chance of being picked up and shared.
What you can do this week with VRITIMES:
li_points: Distribute your year-end results, holiday trading news or a January announcement with guaranteed media placement (count depends on plan).
Point the backlink to your launch or product page.
Use the distribution report to review results and plan Q1.
captions_meta.li_close: Current plans and pricing are on our official page.
captions_meta.fb: Don't let your news land after everyone's gone to the beach. See VRITIMES plans here.
